mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO voucher_entry (voucher_id, account_code, account_name, summary, debit_amount, credit_amount, seq) VALUES
(#{entry.voucherId}, #{entry.accountCode}, #{entry.accountName}, #{entry.summary}, #{entry.debitAmount}, #{entry.creditAmount}, #{entry.seq})
mapper.select: SELECT ve.*, v.voucher_no, v.voucher_date FROM voucher_entry ve JOIN voucher v ON ve.voucher_id = v.id WHERE ve.account_code = #{accountCode} AND v.period = #{period} AND v.status = 'POSTED' ORDER BY v.voucher_date, v.voucher_no, ve.seq
